mechanics: write the derived primary vtable 0x013fe728 at +0x00 and the derived secondary vtable 0x013fe718 at +0x04 before any teardown
release the handle at +0x68 through its vtable slot +0x04 when it is non null
release the handle at +0x64 through its vtable slot +0x04 when it is non null
the late handle at +0x68 is torn down before the early handle at +0x64
destroy the service subobject at +0x2c then the one at +0x14
read the low byte of the deleting word only after the whole teardown has run
restore the base secondary vtable 0x013ec458 at +0x04 and the base primary vtable 0x013eb938 at +0x00
call the deallocation port 0x00f47380 with the receiver when the deleting low bit is set
return the receiver unchanged on every gate
no byte of the receiver outside the two vtable slots is written
